name: Oakland Adult & Career Education
description: Adult education including GED, ESL, and career training in Oakland
fullDescription: Oakland Adult & Career Education (OACE), part of Oakland Unified School District, provides classes for adults including GED and high school diploma preparation, ESL, and career training.
whatTheyOffer:
- GED and high school diploma programs
- ESL (English as a Second Language) classes
- Free ESL for OUSD parents through the Family Literacy Program
- Healthcare training (Phlebotomy Technician, Clinical Medical Assistant, EKG Technician, Medical Billing & Coding) in partnership with CALRegional
- Classes at multiple Oakland locations
howToGetIt:
1. Attend a general student registration session (held before each term; Winter term registration begins in October)
2. Complete registration and assessment at the OACE testing center
3. Enroll in appropriate classes
4. Office hours Monday-Thursday, 9am-4pm; call with questions
keywords: adult school, Oakland, Alameda, GED, ESL, high school diploma, adult education, career training, free classes
